title: Macfarlanes selects Legora as a firm-wide AI partner
summary: Macfarlanes is rolling Legora out across its practice areas, following a pilot and a detailed evaluation this year.
body_markdown:
Macfarlanes is rolling Legora out across its practice areas, following a pilot and a detailed evaluation this year.


Legora, the agentic operating system for legal professionals, today announced that Macfarlanes is rolling out Legora firm-wide. The decision follows a pilot and a detailed evaluation by a firm with long hands-on experience of generative AI.


Headquartered in London, Macfarlanes advises a global client base in private capital, private wealth, M&A and disputes. The firm has been at the forefront of AI adoption in law, having worked with generative AI since 2023. Macfarlanes chose Legora to drive forward how a leading London firm delivers for clients, in legal work and beyond it.


“Macfarlanes came to this evaluation with years of practical AI experience and a clear ambition to make AI part of how the whole firm works,” said **** Alex Fortescue-Webb, Global Head of Legal Engineering and Head of UK&I at Legora **.** “That makes its decision to build with Legora particularly significant. The same legal engineers that worked with Macfarlanes during its pilot are working alongside the firm’s Innovation & AI and practice teams to develop Skills around their own legal work, so the wider rollout starts with capabilities shaped by Macfarlanes’ expertise, priorities and standards.”


Macfarlanes’ lawyers join more than 140,000 legal professionals using Legora across over 80 markets worldwide.


**About Macfarlanes**
Macfarlanes is a pre-eminent law firm that serves a global client base in Private Capital, Private Wealth, M&A and Disputes. The firm has offices in London, Brussels and New York.


**About Legora**
Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 140,000 legal professionals at more than 2,500 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 80 markets
